prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, Arabian desert in the 7th century, bright warm daylight, vibrant natural colours, high detail. The sun disc is NOT visible. No people, no faces, no text, no buildings. On a flat sandy plain stands a single large lone desert acacia tree (Acacia tortilis, samur), about five metres tall, with ONE thick gnarled grey trunk - a single trunk, not two - leaning slightly to the left, its bark rough and peeling in strips, splitting into a few crooked branches above head height, and a very wide flat umbrella-shaped crown of tiny green leaves and thorny twigs, the crown much wider than the tree is tall. The light comes from high above, so the crown casts a wide dappled shadow on the sand directly beneath it. In that shadow at the foot of the trunk: a folded brown wool cloak lying on the sand, an empty wooden bowl beside it, and a plain straight wooden walking staff propped diagonally against the trunk: its upper end rests on the bark of the trunk, its lower end on the sand half a metre away - it is NOT standing upright on its own and NOT stuck in the sand. All of them fully in the shade. No person, no animal. Camera at a distance so the whole tree and its shadow are in frame, vast empty desert around, wide sky.
